entities.name: PMID:10736140
observations: 2000 qualitative evaluation of Boston HAPPENS, a network serving HIV-positive, homeless, and at-risk youth aged 12–24.
Four focus groups with 18 youth assessed medical care, mental health/substance-abuse care, HIV prevention/care, case management, and financial allocation.

Youth reported name recognition, comfort receiving care, and appreciation for comprehensive services; they requested one-on-one mental-health counseling and more recreational/support opportunities for youth living with HIV.

entities.name: Boston HAPPENS youth views
observations: In four focus groups involving 18 youth, participants generally viewed Boston HAPPENS services positively while identifying desired improvements in mental-health counseling and recreational/support services.
